description: Every valuation satisfying both parent clauses satisfies their resolvent on any atom.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.resolve_sound.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] {p : α}
  {C D : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Clause α} (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α)
  (hC : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSat v C) (hD : Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSat v D) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ClauseSat v (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.resolvent p C D)
